d:
Bihar men sarkari naukri ki taiyari kar rahe yuvaon ke lie bari khabar hai. rajasv evan bhumi sudhar vibhag men 3310 padon par bharti ki prakriya shuru hone ja rahi hai. is bharti ke tahat alag-alag padon par niyukti hogi, jisse naukri ki talash kar rahe abhyarthiyon ko bara mauka mil sakta hai. janie kis pad par kitni vaikensi, yogyata, aavedan prakriya aur bharti se juri puri jankari.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
